derived.name: Earnings yield minus US 10Y yield
derived.how: Earnings yield less US 10Y Treasury yield
derived.note: Negative means bonds yield more than equities earn. India 10Y yield has no reliable free feed, so US 10Y is used.

derived.name: Earnings yield minus RBI repo rate
derived.how: Earnings yield less policy repo rate

derived.name: Nifty 50 P/E percentile vs own tracked history
derived.how: Share of tracked days with a P/E at or below today's
derived.note: Only 4 days tracked so far. Shown once 60 days exist; a reliable 5Y view needs years of history.

derived.name: India VIX position in 52-week range
derived.note: Low readings mean complacency; high mean fear.

derived.name: Gift Nifty premium / discount to Nifty close
derived.note: Hint for next open. Futures carry cost is included.

derived.name: Sectoral indices up today
derived.how: Count of NSE sectoral indices with positive 1-day change

derived.name: Market cap / nominal GDP
derived.how: NSE market cap / FY26 RE nominal GDP (Rs 354.09 lakh cr, STATIC)
derived.note: Different basis from the January sheet (which used about Rs 272-280 lakh cr), so the two are NOT comparable. GDP denominator is static.

derived.name: Gold / silver ratio
derived.how: Gold USD per oz / silver USD per oz

derived.name: Gold parity price (INR per 10 g)
derived.note: International parity before import duty, GST and premiums. Not the MCX price.

derived.name: Silver parity price (INR per kg)
derived.note: International parity before duty, GST and premiums. Not the MCX price.

derived.name: Nifty put/call ratio (OI), expiry 06-Oct-2026
derived.how: Total put OI / total call OI
derived.note: Above 1 is often read as supportive; below 0.7 as bearish. A crowd gauge, not a forecast.

derived.name: Nifty max pain, expiry 06-Oct-2026
derived.how: Strike where option writers' total payout is lowest
